name: Rena's Hairpin
note: Allen's Mansion, Salva (MF_0004_26A): EVENT_COLLISION that hands over the hairpin (600200 -> 600500). Held, the party stays free to walk Salva and the world map (no story blocker or map-jump restriction covers the mansion exit); the Salva Mines story needs 600500.

name: Travel Permit
note: Krosse Castle (MF_0007_01A): EVENT_COLLISION after the audience that grants the permit (1001500 -> 1100000). Fast travel is enabled from 900000 and not disabled in the castle then, so a held party can always leave.

name: Treasure Map
note: Krosse City (MF_0006_01A): Celine's EVENT_COLLISION that produces the map (1100000 -> 1200000); Krosse Cave opens with ev_1200000. Hub town, no blocker or fast-travel disable in the window.

name: Mud Shoes
note: Marze (MF_0010_01A): the elder's morning scene, ENTER_FIELD, one variant per route (Claude 1501500 -> 1502000, Rena 1501500 -> 1501700 then ev_1501700_r to 1502000). The Forest of Symbols blocker ev_sub_012000 lifts at 1502000. Walking exits are blocked in this window (ev_block_mars_03) but fast travel out of Marze is not disabled; re-enter Marze after receipt to start the scene.

name: House Key
note: Forest of Symbols (MF_0011_01A), Rena's route only: ENTER_FIELD cabin scene (1506300 -> 1506400). Claude's route has no House Key scene. Fast travel is not disabled until 1506400; re-enter the forest map after receipt.

name: Armory Contest Badge
note: Lacuer City: the four sponsor CONVERSATIONs, one of which gives the badge (1801500 -> 1802000). All four are held, so no sponsor accepts until the badge arrives. Fast travel out of Lacuer is not disabled in this window.

name: ID Card
note: Eluria Settlement armory (MF_0026_21A): EVENT_COLLISION that grants the card (Claude 3101000 -> 3200000, Rena -> 3300000). Eluria Tower opens at 3300000. Fast travel out of Eluria is not disabled in this window.

name: Rune Code
note: City Hall (MF_0030_26A): EVENT_COLLISION, the same event as chapter key 5 The Four Fields (4100000 -> 4200000, live-traced). The Field of Love barrier (ev_sub_165200) additionally tests the item itself. Replaces chapter key 5 when both options are on.

name: Orb of Wisdom
note: Field of Wisdom core (MF_0036_31A): ENTER_FIELD orb scene, the only setter of FLAG_INTELLIGENCE_FIELD, which the Phynal Expedition event ev_4600000 requires (-> 4700000). Re-enter the core room after receipt.

name: Orb of Might
note: Field of Might shrine (MF_0037_04A): ENTER_FIELD orb scene, the only setter of FLAG_FORCE_FIELD (required by ev_4600000). Re-enter the shrine room after receipt.

name: Idol of the Warrior
note: Field of Courage statue (MF_0038_01A): CONVERSATION that gives the idol and sets FLAG_FOC_GETITEM, which the Guardian event ev_4207000 (battle 525) reads before it sets FLAG_FOC_PUT_ITEM for the Courage orb scenes. Field of Courage chests are conservatively gated too: which of them sit past the Guardian is not established.

name: Orb of Courage
note: Field of Courage (MF_0038_01A): ENTER_FIELD orb scene per route (Rena ev_4207500_r, Claude ev_4208500), the only setters of FLAG_COURAGE_FIELD (required by ev_4600000). Re-enter the map after receipt.

name: Orb of Love
note: Field of Love core (MF_0039_31A): ENTER_FIELD orb scene, the only setter of FLAG_LOVE_FIELD (required by ev_4600000). Re-enter the core room after receipt.

name: Minae Cave Key Card
note: Armlock, Mirage's home (MF_0040_23A): ENTER_FIELD card scene (5400500 -> 5500000); the Minae Cave door panel (ev_sub_400000) stays locked until 5500000. Fast travel out of Armlock is not disabled in this window; re-enter the house after receipt.

name: LEA Metal
note: Minae Cave entrance (MF_0042_01A): ENTER_FIELD scene after Barchian that yields the metal (5501000 -> 5600000). Re-enter the entrance map after receipt.

name: N.P.I.D.
note: Armlock, Mirage's home (MF_0040_23A): EVENT_COLLISION where the metal is handed over and the N.P.I.D. issued (5600000 -> 5700000). The Fun City reception also tests the item natively (free entry).
